subtitle: Cross-check of September 16, 2026, reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT (15:41 UTC), with the presidential book at USD 150.50M. All five tracked contracts received a new price in this round: winner, first-round runner-up, first-round third place, Supreme Court impeachment and Senate. On the polling side, one national poll was released today: DataTrends, fieldwork from Sep 12 to 14, 2,000 interviews by automated telephone, margin of 2.19pp, register BR-08691/2026 at the Superior Electoral Court. It gives the first round to Lula and the runoff to Flávio Bolsonaro by 1 point, inside the margin.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 44.50% (vol USD 11.16M accumulated) in the winner contract, reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, down 2.00pp against the price confirmed on Sep 15. POLLS: 39% in the first round and 44% in the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro in the Sep 16 DataTrends poll.
fortes: Leads the first round of the Sep 16 DataTrends poll by 39% to 35%, four points that fit inside two margins of 2.19.
Wins the three other runoff pairs that the DataTrends sources confirm: 46% to 39% against Romeu Zema and 42% to 37% against Augusto Cury, outside two margins, and 44% to 41% against Ronaldo Caiado.
In the first-round runner-up contract he rises 2.00pp, to 23.85%.
fracos: Falls 2.00pp in the winner contract, to 44.50%, and the gap to Flávio Bolsonaro widens from 5.45pp to 9.25pp.
In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he loses the runoff pair to Flávio Bolsonaro by 44% to 45%, a 1-point difference that fits inside the margin, that is, a statistical tie in that house.
His price is 23.00pp below the series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16.
candidates.analise: The round is one of a fall in the market and a statistical tie in the day's poll. In the winner contract he falls 2.00pp, to 44.50% (vol USD 11.16M accumulated), and the gap to Flávio Bolsonaro widens from 5.45pp to 9.25pp, with both sides moving. In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he leads the first round by 4 points and trails the runoff by 1 point, inside the margin. The three national polls released on Sep 15 and 16 agree in putting him ahead in the first round and do not agree on the runoff: Indexa/Broadcast and DataTrends, both by telephone, give a 1-point distance with opposite signs, and CNT/MDA, in person, gives 7.3 points in his favor. In the first-round runner-up contract he rises 2.00pp, to 23.85%. The panel does not claim the market reacted to the poll: the order between the two measurements is not measured.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 53.75% (vol USD 10.82M accumulated) in the winner contract, reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, up 1.80pp against the price confirmed on Sep 15. POLLS: 35% in the first round and 45% in the runoff against Lula in the Sep 16 DataTrends poll.
fortes: Rises 1.80pp in the winner contract, to 53.75%, and the gap to Lula widens from 5.45pp to 9.25pp.
In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he wins the runoff pair against Lula by 45% to 44%, a 1-point difference that fits inside the margin of 2.19, so that house measures a statistical tie.
His price stands 1.35pp below the series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10.
fracos: Trails in the first round of DataTrends, with 35% against 39% for Lula, a distance that fits inside two margins.
In the first-round runner-up contract he gives up 1.00pp, to 75.50%, while Lula's side rises 2.00pp.
In the Sep 15 CNT/MDA poll, in person, he remains 7.3 points behind Lula in the runoff, outside two margins, and DataTrends does not undo that reading, it only measures another one.
candidates.analise: The round is one of a rise in the market and a minimal numerical lead in the day's poll. In the winner contract he rises 1.80pp, to 53.75% (vol USD 10.82M accumulated), and the gap to Lula widens 3.80pp, with the opponent falling 2.00pp in the same reading. The 53.75% sits 1.35pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he wins the runoff by 1 point and loses the first round by 4, both distances inside the margins. The polling reading depends on the house: Indexa/Broadcast puts him 1 point behind in the runoff, DataTrends 1 point ahead and CNT/MDA 7.3 points behind, and the panel records all three without choosing. In the first-round runner-up contract he gives up 1.00pp, to 75.50%.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.25% in the winner contract, reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, down 0.20pp. In the first-round third-place contract he rises 0.10pp against the value published on Sep 14, to 45.50% (vol USD 198 thousand accumulated), where he is the favorite. POLLS: 6% in the first round in the Sep 16 DataTrends poll.
fortes: He is third in the first round of the Sep 16 DataTrends poll, with 6%, the same value he had in the two national polls of Sep 15.
In the first-round third-place contract he remains the favorite, at 45.50%, up 0.10pp against the value published on Sep 14, and the distance to Renan Santos widens from 7.90pp to 9.00pp.
fracos: Gives up 0.20pp in the winner contract, to 0.25%, below the lowest value among the recorded readings of his series, of 0.30% on Sep 10.
Loses the runoff pair to Lula in DataTrends by 37% to 42%, a 5-point distance that falls outside two margins of 2.19.
candidates.analise: The round measures stability in the polls and two small market moves, in opposite directions. In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he has 6% in the first round, the same value as in the two national polls of Sep 15, and loses the runoff pair to Lula by 5 points, outside two margins. In the winner contract he gives up 0.20pp, to 0.25%, below the lowest value among the recorded readings of his series. In the first-round third-place contract, which is where he has a relevant price and which gets a new price again in this round, he rises 0.10pp, to 45.50% (vol USD 198 thousand accumulated), and remains the favorite.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 1.35% (vol USD 13.54M accumulated) in the winner contract, reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, down 0.30pp. In the first-round third-place contract he falls 1.00pp against the value published on Sep 14, to 36.50% (vol USD 311 thousand accumulated). POLLS: 4% in the first round in the Sep 16 DataTrends poll.
fortes: His contract has the second-largest accumulated volume in the presidential book, at USD 13.54M, behind only Tarcísio de Freitas's, and above the contracts of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.
Has 4% in the first round of the Sep 16 DataTrends poll, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema.
In the first-round third-place contract he remains second, at 36.50%.
fracos: Gives up 0.30pp in the winner contract, to 1.35%, and sits 0.15pp above his series floor, of 1.20% on Aug 31.
In the first-round third-place contract he falls 1.00pp, to 36.50%, and the distance to Augusto Cury widens to 9.00pp.
candidates.analise: The round measures a fall in both contracts where he has a price. In the winner contract he gives up 0.30pp, to 1.35% (vol USD 13.54M accumulated), and sits 0.15pp above the series floor, of 1.20% on Aug 31. In the first-round third-place contract he falls 1.00pp against the value published on Sep 14, to 36.50%, and remains behind Augusto Cury. In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he has 4% in the first round. The contrast the panel records is between volume and price: his contract is the second-largest in the presidential book by accumulated volume and pays 1.35%. High volume measures interest accumulated since the book opened, not probability now.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado at 0.15% in the winner contract, stable, reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT; Romeu Zema at 0.15%, stable; Fernando Haddad at 0.05%, stable. In the first-round third-place contract Ronaldo Caiado stays at the same 15.50% as the value published on Sep 14 (vol USD 130 thousand accumulated). POLLS: Ronaldo Caiado with 3% and Romeu Zema with 1% in the Sep 16 DataTrends poll.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the front group, with prices from the reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT and polling from the Sep 16 DataTrends poll.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.15% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the first-round THIRD-PLACE contract he stays at 15.50%, the same value published on Sep 14, in a book of USD 130 thousand. Has 3% in the first round of the Sep 16 DataTrends poll.
caiado.fortes: In the runoff pair against Lula in the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he loses by 41% to 44%, a 3-point distance that fits inside two margins of 2.19.
caiado.fracos: Has 3% in the first round of DataTrends, behind Augusto Cury and Renan Santos. In the winner contract he remains at 0.15%, with no movement.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, at the book floor. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the Sep 16 DataTrends poll does not test him in a first-round presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in today's reading, so there is no movement to explain, and his series high in the winner contract is 7.60%, on May 26.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the first round by the Sep 16 national poll, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.15% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. Has 1% in the first round of the Sep 16 DataTrends poll.
zema.fortes: Keeps 1% in the first round, the same value as in the two national polls of Sep 15.
zema.fracos: Loses the runoff pair to Lula in DataTrends by 39% to 46%, 7 points that fall outside two margins. In the winner contract he remains at 0.15%, and his series high is 12.00%, on May 13.

candidates.analise: The round does not move the three in the winner contract: Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema remain at 0.15% and Fernando Haddad at 0.05%, the same values as the confirmed reading of Sep 15. In the first-round third-place contract, which gets a new price again in this round, Ronaldo Caiado stays at the same 15.50% published on Sep 14. In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll, Caiado has 3% and Zema 1% in the first round, and the runoff pairs against Lula sit 3 points away for Caiado, inside two margins, and 7 points away for Zema, outside them.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado loses the runoff pair against Lula in the Sep 16 DataTrends poll by 3 points, inside two margins.
Romeu Zema keeps 1% in the first round, the same value as in the two national polls of Sep 15.
The three winner prices were stable in today's reading, with no movement to explain.
fracos: The three of them add up to 0.35% in the winner contract, and none of them goes above 0.15% individually.
Romeu Zema loses the runoff pair to Lula in DataTrends by 7 points, outside two margins.
Fernando Haddad is not measured in the first round by the Sep 16 national poll, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round.

cruzamento: 📈 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT WIDENED AGAIN, AND BOTH SIDES MOVED: Flávio Bolsonaro rose from 51.95% to 53.75% (vol USD 10.82M) and Lula fell from 46.50% to 44.50% (vol USD 11.16M), reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, against the price confirmed on Sep 15. The distance went from 5.45pp to 9.25pp. Neither price is an extreme. 🗳️ ON THE POLLING SIDE, THE Sep 16 DATATRENDS POLL COMPLETES A TRIO OF NATIONAL POLLS IN TWO DAYS, AND THE FINDING IS THE INSTRUMENT. The two houses that interviewed by telephone, Indexa/Broadcast on Sep 15 and DataTrends today, measure the runoff pair with a 1-point distance and the opposite sign: 43% to 42% for Lula in one and 45% to 44% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the other, both inside one margin. CNT/MDA, the only in-person poll of the three, measures 7.3 points for Lula. The panel records all three without choosing and does not claim the market reacted to any of them. 🏛️ AT THE SUPREME COURT, THE REVIEW OF WHETHER TO INVESTIGATE ALEXANDRE DE MORAES WAS SUSPENDED ON Sep 15, WITH NO DECISION, by Flávio Dino's request for more time to review the case, and he has up to 90 days to return it. The contract that pays out if a Supreme Court justice leaves by impeachment before 2027 stands at 4.85%, 0.10pp below the previous day and with no new money in the book. 🗂️ AND A CHANGE IN THE LIST OF CANDIDATES: the Superior Electoral Court rejected Pablo Marçal's registration on Sep 11, and on Sep 15 the PRTB announced Leonardo Avalanche as its candidate in his place, a substitution still under review by the Court. The presidential book has no contract with Avalanche's name, and Marçal's remains at the floor, at 0.05%.
